global.title: Agile Space Industries Strengthens Board and Corporate Development to Support Continued Growth
global.summary: DURANGO, Colo., Oct. 5, 2026 — Agile Space Industries today announced that Jonathan Baliff has joined its Board of Directors, bringing extensive experience in aerospace, finance, and corporate leadership. His appointment, alongside the addition of Theo Squires as Director of Strategy & Corporate Development, strengthens Agile’s ability to execute its long-term growth strategy, support capital formation, and pursue strategic opportunities as the company continues to scale. global.title: Do you really need space-grade components?
global.summary: One challenge in the industry is that we’ve gotten comfortable using the term “space-grade” as if everyone agrees on what it means. I don’t think they do.

global.title: Pentagon betting on solar power from space
global.summary: WASHINGTON — The Pentagon is funding technology to beam solar power from space to Earth, pursuing a potential source of electricity for military installations that depend on vulnerable fuel supply lines. Its latest investment backs Overview Energy, a Virginia startup developing satellites that would transmit energy to large solar arrays on the ground.
